question: Atal Bhujal Yojana (Atal Jal) is targeted at sustainable ________ management.
solution:
The correct answer is __**groundwater**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Atal Bhujal Yojana (Atal Jal) is a central sector scheme of the Government of India aimed at sustainable management of **groundwater resources**.
 
• The scheme was launched on **25th December 2019** by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• It is implemented by the Ministry of Jal Shakti and funded by the Government of India and the World Bank.
 
• Atal Bhujal Yojana focuses on areas with critical and over-exploited groundwater resources, covering **seven states**: Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The primary goal of the scheme is to promote **community-led** sustainable groundwater management, involving local communities and stakeholders in its execution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Groundwater Depletion**

 
 
• Groundwater depletion refers to the long-term reduction in the quantity of groundwater stored in aquifers.
 
• It is primarily caused by excessive extraction for agricultural, industrial, and domestic purposes.
 
• Consequences include reduced water supply, increased pumping costs, and land subsidence.
 
 
 
• **Aquifers**
 
 
• Aquifers are underground layers of water-bearing rock or materials such as gravel, sand, or silt.
 
• They store groundwater and release it to wells or springs.
 
• Aquifers can be confined or unconfined based on their geological characteristics.
 
 
 
• **Water Conservation Techniques**
 
 
• Water conservation techniques include rainwater harvesting, efficient irrigation methods, and wastewater recycling.
 
• Drip irrigation and sprinkler systems are effective methods to reduce water usage in agriculture.
 
• Rainwater harvesting involves collecting and storing rainwater for reuse, reducing dependency on groundwater.
 
 
 
• **Community Participation**
 
 
• Community participation in water management involves engaging local stakeholders in decision-making processes.
 
• It ensures sustainable and equitable distribution of water resources.
 
• Successful groundwater management requires active involvement of communities in monitoring and conservation efforts.
